content.comment_body: Hello, Do I need to install the software from a CD drive? I don't have a CD reader connected to my computer.

[product_name] is only available from [company_name] on DVD. If you don't have a DVD drive, you can use a friend's computer with a DVD drive to copy the DVD to a USB stick. Alternatively, you can submit a support request to [company_name] and explain your situation.

You can use another PC with a DVD drive as suggested by [user_name], or you could purchase an external USB DVD drive and connect it to your computer. Currently, [product_name] is only distributed on DVD. [product_name] Support Team

analysis.insight_summary: The user cannot install [product_name] because their computer lacks a DVD drive, and the software is only provided on physical DVD media. Forum replies and official support members suggest using another computer with a DVD drive to transfer the files via USB, or purchasing an external USB DVD drive. The reliance on physical media creates an unnecessary challenge for users without this hardware.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants to obtain and install [product_name] without requiring a DVD drive, preferring a more straightforward download or installation process.
